question: As of November 2022, who among the following is the Administrator of Lakshadweep, India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Praful Patel.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lakshadweep is the smallest union territory of India.**
 
• **Praful Patel is currently the Administrator of Lakshadweep**.
 
 
• He is also the Administrator of Dadra Nagar Haveli and Daman& Diu.
 
 
 
• **It has 36 islands.** 
 
• The islands cover 32 sq km and **the capital of Lakshadweep Islands is Kavaratti **which is also the major city of UT.
 
• All the islands are located in the Arabian Sea which is 220 to 440 km from the coastal city of Kochi in Kerala.
 
• **Andrott Island is the largest island and has an area of 4.90 km.**
 
• It is in the east-west direction, between 10°48' and 10°50' N latitude and 73°38' and 73°42' E longitude.
 
• As per the 2011 census, Lakshadweep has a population of 64429.
 
• About 93% of the total population is Muslim.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88befc015c502fda19f05335e77ee37167b0ddde9279fbe9c5a0deff188db1e2.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mamata Banerjee**

 
 
• She is the current Chief Minister of West Bengal and has no connection with the administration of Lakshadweep.
 
 
 
• **Devendra Kumar Joshi**
 
 
• He is a retired Indian Navy officer and was appointed as the Lieutenant Governor of Andaman and Nicobar Islands in October 2021.
 
 
 
• **Manoj Sinha**
 
 
• He is the Lieutenant Governor of Jammu and Kashmir and assumed office in August 2020.
